description: Three-band analog equaliser and one-knob compressor for a stereo pair, in 4HP

params.text: Sets the level of the frequencies above 2567Hz, boosting by at most 6dB and cutting to silence
Sets the level of the band between 256Hz and 2567Hz, boosting by at most 6dB and cutting to silence
Sets the level of the frequencies below 256Hz, boosting by at most 6dB and cutting to silence
Sets the compression ratio, from none through gentle to heavy and distorted; makeup gain is applied automatically to keep the output level steady

inputs.text: The right input; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both channels

outputs.text: The left channel after the equaliser and the compressor, at modular level between -10V and 10V
The right channel after the equaliser and the compressor, at modular level between -10V and 10V

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
